answer: One concrete defense is binding identity to scarce, verifiable hardware instead of a free keypair: each agent presents an attestation quote from a unique secure element, so a single owner cannot quietly mint a thousand wallets from one machine. Admission weight follows that anchored cost, and a rotating peer quorum co-signs every newcomer, exposing clusters that share one substrate. A mesa is broad and open, yet each approach leaves a distinct footprint; trust should climb like a vine on proven roots, not sprout from seedless clones, and umber pigment is ground once, not claimed twice.
